technique_name: Tell me about the Lassen Volcanic National Park.
description: Lassen Volcanic National Park is located in northeastern California, about 30 miles east of Redding. The park is characterized by four volcanoes-Lassen Peak, Prospect Peak, Brokeoff Mountain, and Chaos Crags, which erupted between 1914 and 1921. Although no eruptions have occurred since, Lassen is still an active volcano and visitors to the park can often see steam rising from vents in the ground.
